plan.measurement: Compiled V1 natural-stop generation check for AR, selected native static and full-budget adaptive. Same source-ID-aligned population and stopping cap across arms.
plan.notes: Each strategy is a separate compiled campaign with a 900-second limit including engine load and warmup. The canonical commands are cloned from roles ar, static and adaptive in runs/controller_preparation_compiled_r01/evaluation_commands.json: replace only --config and --run with the compiled natural-check names above, then add --natural-stop, retaining all other prepared arguments. The run_commands strings are documentation templates, not executable configuration; SELECTED_STATIC_GAMMA must be resolved from the prepared static command and its referenced selection, including gamma0 if selected. Required CLI flags are documented, not activated by this JSON; natural stopping requires --natural-stop. AR uses proposal budget0; the selected native static uses its selected gamma as both gamma and proposal budget; adaptive pays proposal budget7 and uses only the matching compiled full-budget calibration. Fixed readable samples are workload positions 64-71 at minimum selected batch and repeat0; all cells, all 16 requests, and both repetitions enter summaries. No output-based selection, GPU execution, or upload is performed by preparing this config.
